# Core Summary
A melancholic 10-second cinematic piece in the style of 90s Hong Kong Art Cinema, featuring a solitary figure in a rain-soaked red telephone booth under neon lights. The clip follows a three-shot progression: an exterior view through rain-streaked glass, an intimate extreme close-up of a whispered confession, and a signature slow-shutter departure into the city night. The narrative anchors on the theme of memory and expiration, delivered through a soft English dialogue line against a yellow-green graded, grainy backdrop.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:04] Night. A vintage red public telephone booth stands on a wet city street. Heavy rain flows down the glass panels, distorting the interior view. Street neon signs reflect on the wet pavement, casting a yellow-green ambient glow. High ISO film grain is visible throughout. Shallow depth of field focuses on the raindrops on the glass, blurring the figure inside.
Audio: Heavy rain falling, distant city hum, low-frequency ambient drone.

[shot2][00:04-00:07] Interior/Extreme Close-up. The background is a bokeh of flowing neon lights, bright and dim alternately. The lighting is low-key with high contrast, emphasizing the texture of skin and rain mist. The yellow-green tint is prominent.
Audio: Rain sound fades slightly, focus shifts to intimate proximity noise.

[shot3][00:07-00:10] Exterior/Wide Shot. The street is wet with elongated car light trails in the background. The environment is dark but punctuated by streaks of red and white light. Motion blur and frame-stepping effects are visible in the air.
Audio: Rain returns to foreground, footsteps on wet pavement, fading city noise.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>
*   Gender: Male.
*   Race/Ethnicity: East Asian.
*   Age: Young adult.
*   Appearance features: Wearing a wet khaki trench coat, dark hair slightly damp. Facial features are sharp but obscured by shadow and glass refraction in wider shots.
*   Vocal Characteristics: Soft, intimate whisper, slightly breathy, melancholic tone, slow rhythm.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:04] <ID_A> stands inside the red telephone booth, positioned center-frame behind the rain-covered glass. He holds the black receiver tightly to his ear with his right hand, body still. Rain streams down the glass in rivulets, distorting his face like an oil painting. His eyes appear hollow yet emotional through the refraction. The camera is handheld, slightly floating, focusing on the glass texture while <ID_A> remains a blurred silhouette. No dialogue, only the sound of heavy rain.

[shot2][00:04-00:07] Cut-in to extreme close-up on <ID_A>'s lips and lower face. Neon bokeh shifts across his skin. His lips tremble slightly as he whispers softly into the receiver. <ID_A> (melancholic whisper) says: [00:04-00:07]「If memories were canned food, I hope they never expire.」He swallows the last words, showing restraint. The camera holds steady on the mouth movement, capturing the micro-expression of longing.

[shot3][00:07-00:10] Cut-out to wide shot. <ID_A> hangs up the phone, turns around, and walks away from the booth into the rainy crowd. As he moves, a frame-stepping effect creates trailing shadows and motion blur, making his back appear blurred as if the soul stayed behind. He walks toward the background deep space, away from the camera. The background car lights form elongated streaks. The image freezes slightly with high grain as he disappears into the night.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
90s Hong Kong Art Cinema aesthetic (Wong Kar-wai influence). High ISO film grain, yellow-green color grading, and ambiguous lighting. Shallow depth of field with strong bokeh. Visual effects include step-printing (drag shutter) for motion blur and frame stepping. The image should feel textured, slightly imperfect, and emotionally dense. Lighting is low-key neon, creating high contrast between shadows and specular highlights on wet surfaces.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Melancholic, lonely, and nostalgic. The atmosphere is heavy with rain and unspoken emotion. The pacing is slow and deliberate, emphasizing the weight of memory. The visual distortion and motion blur reinforce the theme of fading memories and emotional distance.
